int_name: N CHRISTOPHER COLUMBUS BLVD & S CHRISTOPHER COLUMBUS BLVD

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane roadway with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a signalized intersection. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the significant crossing distance and lack of a pedestrian refuge island increase exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross three lanes of traffic in a single stage without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Vegetation
hazards.description: Dense trees on the left sidewalk may obscure pedestrians waiting to cross from the view of approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, adjacent to the sidewalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The environment features a wide multi-lane roadway with a marked continental crosswalk and curb ramps, but lacks significant pedestrian protection. The proximity to an elevated highway and large industrial-style buildings suggests a high-speed, vehicle-oriented area with long crossing distances.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk spanning the main road

hazards.name: Wide Travel Lanes
hazards.description: The width of the lanes likely encourages higher vehicle speeds in an area with pedestrian crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway in the foreground and middle ground

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the crossing to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Ensure visible pedestrian signals with countdown timers are installed at all legs of the intersection.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is extremely hostile, featuring a wide multi-lane arterial road passing under a bridge with no marked crossings. A 'Pedestrians Prohibited' sign is clearly visible on the signal pole, indicating that the infrastructure is designed solely for motor vehicles and lacks any safe accommodation for people walking.

hazards.name: Pedestrian Prohibition
hazards.description: A sign explicitly prohibits pedestrians from using this area, indicating a high-speed, vehicle-only environment.
hazards.location_in_image: On the traffic signal pole on the right side of the image

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Bridge Structure
hazards.description: The bridge pillars and the shadows created by the underpass can obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Under the bridge structure and around the support pillars

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add zebra or ladder-style pavement markings to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide safe, predictable crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines.

result.summary: The image shows a paved sidewalk running alongside a high concrete retaining wall. The pedestrian environment is basic, providing a dedicated path but lacking any physical buffer from the adjacent roadway or enhanced safety features.

hazards.name: Lack of traffic separation
hazards.description: There is no physical buffer or barrier between the sidewalk and the roadway, exposing pedestrians to moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line at the bottom of the image.

hazards.name: Sidewalk surface degradation
hazards.description: Cracks and weeds are present on the sidewalk surface, which could present minor tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Visible on the sidewalk panels in the foreground.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip, bollards, or street furniture between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracks and remove invasive vegetation to ensure a smooth and safe walking surface.
